origin.description: Alias of stri_opts_collator. Only supplied settings are stored, and normalisation is stored as normalization.

arguments.name: locale, strength, ...
arguments.text: Only arguments that are supplied are stored. NULL or None drops the name. normalisation is stored as normalization.

origin.details: Alias of stri_opts_collator. Only supplied settings are stored, and normalisation is stored as normalization. One leading U+FEFF is removed before compare, sort, order, rank, unique, and duplicated, and the strings those functions return are stripped. stri_sort_key keeps that character and drops only the terminating NUL of the ICU key.
origin.value: A named list of the settings that were supplied.
